scope: Frontend-only code simplification deployed 2026-10-05. Retail/MCP configuration-only rollouts enable NL2SQL; backend and supplier preserved. See deployment-v4-release.json.
source_baseline: deployment_v2 at 1bf6fcb; application release source ba4da521dba5b1da6a4331a99c1735aa20f9ea3a
important: The copied backend directory is the V2 frontend build dependency, NOT an export of the deployed Langfuse backend. Do not rebuild or deploy all five services from this folder.
backend_contract: Existing workflow, selection, draft preview, decision, dispatch and completion endpoints. No new approval bypass or model-generated action execution.

chat_behavior.retail_questions: Use the existing /chat conversation endpoint and configured OCI Responses integration.
chat_behavior.greetings_and_context: Simple greetings are local UI replies. Saved workflows are resumed explicitly; model request context is opt-in. New chat resets the model conversation without deleting saved requests.
chat_behavior.presentation: Compact conversational supplier choices and one next action per request. Exact terms and email are revealed for explicit review before approval controls are shown.
chat_behavior.workflow_actions: Explicit inline controls invoke existing agent workflow APIs.
chat_behavior.supplier_chat: Guided request selection and existing supplier workflow checks. No new free-form supplier LLM endpoint was added.
chat_behavior.human_approval: Explicit review checkbox and decision buttons bound to case version and draft hash. Sending remains a separate action.
chat_behavior.durability: Request IDs and uncertain assessment idempotency keys survive refresh within the current browser session. Conversational UI text is in-memory. Authoritative requests and decisions remain in the backend.

verification: npm run build; npx playwright test --config playwright.chat.config.js (mocked APIs only; no live OCI notifications)
